mapper.sql: SELECT e.id,e.rental_order_id order_id,o.order_no,e.factory_id,e.buyer_user_id buyer_id,e.version,e.created_at, e.extension_status status,e.extra_days,e.original_due_date,e.requested_due_date,e.extension_rent_amount_fen rent_fen,e.payment_order_id payment_id, e.paid_at,e.factory_warning_at warning_at,e.factory_deadline_at deadline_at,e.reject_reason reason,e.refund_order_id refund_id, r.refund_status,r.refund_amount_fen refund_fen,e.latest_paid_at,e.application_remark remark,(SELECT p.expire_at FROM payment_order p WHERE p.id=e.payment_order_id) payment_expire_at FROM order_extension_request e JOIN rental_order o ON o.id=e.rental_order_id LEFT JOIN refund_order r ON r.id=e.refund_order_id

where.if: AND e.factory_id=#{filter.factoryId} AND e.submitted_to_factory_at IS NOT NULL

mapper.select: ORDER BY e.created_at DESC,e.id DESC LIMIT #{page.pageSize} OFFSET #{page.offset}
SELECT id FROM order_extension_request WHERE active_order_guard=#{orderId}
SELECT id FROM order_extension_request WHERE payment_order_id=#{paymentId}

SELECT o.checkout_batch_id FROM payment_order p JOIN payment_channel_suborder s ON s.payment_order_id=p.id JOIN rental_order o ON o.id=s.rental_order_id WHERE p.id=#{paymentId} AND p.payment_scene IN ('extension_rent','compensation_supplement')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_extension_request(id,rental_order_id,buyer_user_id,factory_id,original_due_date,requested_due_date,extra_days, max_extra_days_snapshot,extension_rent_amount_fen,extension_status,latest_paid_at,application_remark,created_at,updated_at) SELECT #{id},o.id,o.buyer_user_id,o.factory_id,#{quote.originalDueDate},#{quote.requestedDueDate},#{quote.extraDays},#{quote.maxExtraDays},#{quote.rentFen}, 'pending_payment',DATE_SUB(DATE_ADD(CAST(#{quote.originalDueDate} AS DATETIME),INTERVAL 1 DAY),INTERVAL 48 HOUR),#{remark},#{at},#{at} FROM rental_order o WHERE o.id=#{quote.orderId} AND o.version=#{quote.orderVersion}

INSERT INTO payment_channel_suborder(id,payment_order_id,factory_id,factory_wechat_account_id,sub_mchid_snapshot,channel_sub_order_no, rental_order_id,channel_suborder_amount_fen,channel_suborder_status,channel_description,profit_sharing_flag,payment_status,paid_amount_fen,refunded_amount_fen, freeze_alert_status,created_at,updated_at) SELECT #{sub},#{payment},e.factory_id,s.factory_wechat_account_id,s.sub_mchid_snapshot,#{sub},e.rental_order_id,e.extension_rent_amount_fen,'pending','道具延期租金', 1,'pending',0,0,'none',#{at},#{at} FROM order_extension_request e JOIN payment_channel_suborder s ON s.rental_order_id=e.rental_order_id JOIN payment_order p ON p.id=s.payment_order_id AND p.payment_scene='initial_order' WHERE e.id=#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE order_extension_request SET payment_order_id=#{payment} WHERE id=#{id} AND payment_order_id IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inventory_reservation(id,sku_id,sn_id,quantity,checkout_batch_id,checkout_batch_item_snapshot_id,rental_order_id,rental_order_item_id, source_type,source_id,rental_start_date,rental_end_date,occupy_start_date,occupy_end_date,reservation_status,expires_at,idempotency_key,version,created_at,updated_at) SELECT #{id},r.sku_id,r.sn_id,r.quantity,r.checkout_batch_id,r.checkout_batch_item_snapshot_id,r.rental_order_id,r.rental_order_item_id,'extension_request',e.id, DATE_ADD(e.original_due_date,INTERVAL 1 DAY),e.requested_due_date,DATE_ADD(r.occupy_end_date,INTERVAL 1 DAY),DATE_ADD(r.occupy_end_date,INTERVAL e.extra_days DAY), 'held',#{expiry},CONCAT('extend:',e.id,':',r.id),0,#{at},#{at} FROM inventory_reservation r JOIN order_extension_request e ON e.rental_order_id=r.rental_order_id WHERE e.id=#{ext} AND r.id=#{source} AND r.reservation_status='renting'
mapper.update: UPDATE inventory_reservation SET reservation_status=#{to},expires_at=NULL,updated_at=#{at},version=version+1 WHERE source_type='extension_request' AND source_id=#{id} AND reservation_status=#{from}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment_allocation(id,payment_order_id,payment_channel_suborder_id,rental_order_id,rent_allocated_amount_fen,coupon_discount_allocated_fen, deposit_allocated_amount_fen,service_fee_allocated_fen,freight_prepaid_allocated_fen,compensation_allocated_amount_fen,custom_goods_allocated_amount_fen,total_allocated_amount_fen,created_at) SELECT #{id},s.payment_order_id,s.id,e.rental_order_id,s.paid_amount_fen,0,0,0,0,0,0,s.paid_amount_fen,#{at} FROM order_extension_request e JOIN payment_channel_suborder s ON s.payment_order_id=e.payment_order_id WHERE e.id=#{ext} AND s.payment_status='success' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM payment_allocation a WHERE a.payment_channel_suborder_id=s.id)
mapper.update: UPDATE rental_order SET total_paid_amount_fen=total_paid_amount_fen+#{fen},rent_paid_amount_fen=rent_paid_amount_fen+#{fen}, version=version+1,updated_at=#{at} WHERE id=#{orderId}

UPDATE order_extension_request SET extension_status='pending_factory',paid_at=#{paidAt},submitted_to_factory_at=#{at}, factory_warning_at=DATE_ADD(#{at},INTERVAL 12 HOUR),factory_deadline_at=DATE_ADD(#{at},INTERVAL 24 HOUR),updated_at=#{at},version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND extension_status='pending_payment'
UPDATE rental_order SET current_due_date=#{ext.requestedDueDate},updated_at=#{at},version=version+1 WHERE id=#{ext.orderId} AND current_due_date=#{ext.originalDueDate}
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM order_extension_request WHERE id>#{after} AND ((extension_status='pending_factory' AND factory_warning_at<=#{at}) OR (extension_status='factory_warning' AND factory_deadline_at<=#{at})) ORDER BY id LIMIT 100
mapper.update: UPDATE order_extension_request SET extension_status='rejected_refunded',version=version+1,updated_at=#{at} WHERE refund_order_id=#{refund} AND extension_status='rejected_refunding'
